notes: Release: images trimmed to builder-codex (as DeepCode). node:24-bookworm-slim and ubuntu:24.04 were listed by the extraction but no file of the tree outside a0 references them; the control plane's brokers and Builder run on builder-codex, and the lower agent runs on the host under bubblewrap.

Environment openclaw-channel-handoff-ledger-edit-v1 is installed from a pinned archive of the runtime-used subset of the paper environment (env/env.json); host tools zstd (unpack) and bwrap (lower-agent and build sandboxes).

Runnable: with deepseek-flash for every role and the restored as-run .pre files in the tree, a readiness smoke completes two accepted dev rounds on the real OpenClaw Gateway with the candidate built offline from the archived environment (round 2 frozen) and hidden test_001 Result 26 (scoreable, publishable; under the 0.94-coverage ceiling of 55, the loss on the candidate: no product calls, no agent_result.json or run_report.json), independent review 10/10, gate READY; the release-provenance formal gate dry run passes.

Release change (2026-10-10): Docker 29 removes an exited or stopped --rm container asynchronously: for several seconds `docker inspect` still shows it and `docker rm -f` answers "removal of container ... is already in progress" (exit 1); Docker 24 has removed it by then. harbor/formal_one_stop.py cleanup_owned_container records rm's stderr and, when rm answers "already in progress" (an --rm broker that exited by itself), waits up to 30 s for the container to be gone before deciding absent_after_cleanup. Any other rm refusal is judged as before, and a container still present after the wait is not absent. Seen with Docker 29.2.1.
